naming_required: static single-structure approximation inspired by Spatial Aggregation Propensity (SAP); NOT identical to canonical dynamic SAP

primary_paper.title: Design of therapeutic proteins with enhanced stability
primary_paper.authors: Chennamsetty N; Voynov V; Kayser V; Helk B; Trout BL

related_paper.title: Aggregation-Prone Motifs in Human Immunoglobulin G

hydrophobicity_scale.name: Black & Mould 1991
hydrophobicity_scale.normalization: Gly-centered (subtract Gly=0.501) as used in SAP implementations

method.software: in-house static SAP on Bio.PDB SASA

formula: SAP_i = sum_{j: d(CA_i,CA_j) <= R} (RASA_j * Hphi_j) where Hphi is Black-Mould Gly-centered; RASA_j = SASA_j/MAX_ASA_j; static single structure (no MD)
radii_source: Chennamsetty SAP commonly reports 5A and 10A spatial cutoffs; frozen before target

round1_distinction.round1: ADV_SURFACE_PATCH / spatial hydrophobicity uses exposed hydrophobic SASA * local density; Kyte-Doolittle; explicitly 'not claiming SAP formula'
round1_distinction.this_family: Black-Mould Gly-centered hydrophobicity * RASA neighborhood sum at R=5/10
